description: Curated visual references; groupings are editorial interpretations, not an official taxonomy. Example dates vary. Visual inspiration does not certify usability or accessibility.
usage: Reference viewing with source credits. Rights remain with the original creators; no production asset license is implied.

directions.title: Quiet / minimalist
directions.summary: Restrained decoration, strong typography and generous breathing room.
directions.watch_for: Keep controls discoverable; calm must not become faint or empty.

examples.title: Ruul
examples.note: A spacious monochrome hero with concise copy and one prominent entry point.
examples.alt: Ruul: A spacious monochrome hero with concise copy and one prominent entry point.

examples.title: Laurenz Marsau
examples.credit: Laurenz Marsau; screenshot published by Wix
examples.note: Oversized type and open space turn a project index into the main composition.
examples.alt: Laurenz Marsau: Oversized type and open space turn a project index into the main composition.

directions.title: Liquid Glass
directions.summary: Translucent layers, reflective edges and controls floating above content.
directions.watch_for: Check contrast over changing backgrounds and retain an opaque fallback.

examples.title: Apple Music controls
examples.note: Floating playback and navigation layers reveal the imagery underneath.
examples.alt: Apple Music controls: Floating playback and navigation layers reveal the imagery underneath.

examples.title: Apple lock-screen material
examples.note: Reflective numerals demonstrate a glass treatment over a dark photographic scene.
examples.alt: Apple lock-screen material: Reflective numerals demonstrate a glass treatment over a dark photographic scene.

directions.title: Warm / organic
directions.summary: Earthy color, soft forms and a human visual character.
directions.watch_for: Preserve text contrast and intentional shapes; avoid decorative clutter.

examples.title: Gormley & Gamble
examples.credit: Gormley & Gamble; screenshot published by Wix
examples.note: A cream canvas, sage texture and organic lettering create a warm identity.
examples.alt: Gormley & Gamble: A cream canvas, sage texture and organic lettering create a warm identity.

examples.title: Anthropic
examples.note: Paper-colored surfaces pair serif text with simple illustrated shapes.
examples.alt: Anthropic: Paper-colored surfaces pair serif text with simple illustrated shapes.

directions.title: Editorial / typography-led
directions.summary: Dramatic type, art-directed imagery and varied reading rhythm.
directions.watch_for: Strong composition still needs readable text and a clear reading order.

examples.title: Vertical portfolio template
examples.note: A split composition combines oversized type, fine rules and monochrome imagery.
examples.alt: Vertical portfolio template: A split composition combines oversized type, fine rules and monochrome imagery.

examples.title: CASA NERO
examples.note: Fashion photography and alternating type-and-image sections create an editorial rhythm.
examples.alt: CASA NERO: Fashion photography and alternating type-and-image sections create an editorial rhythm.

directions.title: Expressive / playful
directions.summary: Confident color, distinctive shapes and lively visual emphasis.
directions.watch_for: Keep meaning clear without relying only on color or animation.

examples.title: Material 3 Expressive
examples.note: Bold color and contrasting control shapes emphasize different actions and roles.
examples.alt: Material 3 Expressive: Bold color and contrasting control shapes emphasize different actions and roles.

examples.title: Tesoro
examples.note: A multicolor palette and shaped panels give the page an energetic character.
examples.alt: Tesoro: A multicolor palette and shaped panels give the page an energetic character.

directions.title: Tactile / handcrafted
directions.summary: Illustration, print texture and a deliberately handmade feel.
directions.watch_for: Use coherent assets and keep textures away from essential text contrast.

examples.title: Dopple Press
examples.credit: Dopple Press; screenshot published by Wix
examples.note: Paper texture, illustrated characters and print-like lettering carry the identity.
examples.alt: Dopple Press: Paper texture, illustrated characters and print-like lettering carry the identity.

examples.title: Rootly
examples.note: A painted landscape frames product UI as an illustrated composition.
examples.alt: Rootly: A painted landscape frames product UI as an illustrated composition.

directions.title: Brutalist / utilitarian
directions.summary: Raw typography, exposed structure and unconventional arrangements.
directions.watch_for: Experimental presentation still needs obvious navigation and usable targets.

examples.title: Pencil
examples.note: Large direct typography and ASCII imagery create a raw, tool-like treatment.
examples.alt: Pencil: Large direct typography and ASCII imagery create a raw, tool-like treatment.

examples.title: Isshī
examples.note: Sparse controls and unconventional object placement illustrate the anti-design end of this family.
examples.alt: Isshī: Sparse controls and unconventional object placement illustrate the anti-design end of this family.

directions.title: Retro / nostalgic
directions.summary: Period typography, early-web motifs and deliberately nostalgic color.
directions.watch_for: Borrow the visual language while keeping contemporary accessibility and behavior.

examples.title: Ryan Haskins
examples.credit: Ryan Haskins; screenshot published by Wix
examples.note: Glossy lettering, oval links and night photography recall early personal websites.
examples.alt: Ryan Haskins: Glossy lettering, oval links and night photography recall early personal websites.

examples.title: VayCay visual concept
examples.note: Memphis-like shapes and bright period colors demonstrate an eighties-inspired direction.
examples.alt: VayCay visual concept: Memphis-like shapes and bright period colors demonstrate an eighties-inspired direction.

directions.title: Immersive / spatial
directions.summary: Scenes, expansive canvases and imagery that become the interface.
directions.watch_for: Provide clear navigation and accessible alternatives to scene or canvas interactions.

examples.title: Lennnie
examples.note: An illustrated room turns site destinations into objects within a scene.
examples.alt: Lennnie: An illustrated room turns site destinations into objects within a scene.

examples.title: Flim
examples.note: A spacious image canvas organizes discovery through freely placed film stills.
examples.alt: Flim: A spacious image canvas organizes discovery through freely placed film stills.
